question_or_proposition: For outfall 001 during Federal FY2025, does the nominated cover-page language establish that discharge to receiving waterbody segment 20.6.4.401 (San Juan River, San Juan Basin) is authorized and that this receiving-water segment designation governs which enforceable numeric discharge limits and discharge-occurrence-dependent monitoring requirements are in scope?
required_context: Part I effluent limitations and any outfall-specific limit tables
Part I monitoring requirements and conditions tied to discharge occurrence or receiving water
Relationship between the cover-page receiving-water designation and operative limit provisions
notes: The nominated clause jointly asserts discharge authorization and identifies a specific receiving water and waterbody segment code. Resolving whether that designation is operative for limit selection and for scoping discharge-triggered monitoring would change Purpose A and Purpose B evaluations; the passage alone does not resolve how it interacts with later permit parts.
